tags.TITLE: We Need To Talk About Dennis
tags.LYRICS:
[Chorus]
We need to talk about Dennis
He only comes out at night
Rocks you like a hurricane
His bark's as big as his bite

[Verse 1]
Alright, the name’s Dennis
Aptly named 'cause I'm a bit of a trouble maker
A rascal, a menace
Not everyone can hack my presence
But that’s their problem
If you hear me coming
Do yourself a favour and move out of my way
Unless you're coming along for the ride
It'll be the ride of your life
We'll take the night, grab it with both hands
And tear it apart with our teeth
Order means nothing when you're out with me

[Chorus]
We need to talk about Dennis
He only comes out at night
Rocks you like a hurricane
His bark's as big as his bite
We need to talk about Dennis
He only comes out at night
Rocks you like a hurricane
His bark's as big as his bite


[Verse 2]
Do you want a friendship with chaos?
Wanna party with Perses?
Consequences mean nothing to me
Morning is your problem, I don't stick around
The damage is done, it’s all you from here
And don’t come a looking 'cause I simply do not care
Like you’d even find me
Well, maybe after a few pints
And I only make an appearance when the time is right
You see, I'm all about the here and now
Live in the moment and all that, carpe diem

[Chorus]
We need to talk about Dennis
He only comes out at night
Rocks you like a hurricane
His bark's as big as his bite
We need to talk about Dennis
He only comes out at night
Rocks you like a hurricane
His bark's as big as his bite

[Verse 3]
Don’t ask questions, don't try to dissect
Don't try to understand me, there's nothing to get
I've got no rhyme, no reason, no thoughts, no feelings
I'm just Dennis, and Dennis does what Dennis wants
You can't quieten or contain this beast
The only thing that can is sleep
And I think sleep is for the weak, and I'm nothing but
The only weakness of mine is Denise
And she's on her way, so I'm gonna have to leave


[Chorus]
We need to talk about Dennis
He only comes out at night
Rocks you like a hurricane
(I'll rock you like a hurricane, baby)
His bark's as big as his bite
We need to talk about Dennis
(Dennis who?)
He only comes out at night
(Lock your doors)
Rocks you like a hurricane
His bark's as big as his bite
(His bark's as big as his bite)
